sample_unit: teams of expert pediatric diabetologists (number not reported)

links.outcome: Clinician usability ratings of AI chatbot versus paper and digital app during simulated DKA management
links.effect: Paper protocol outperformed digital versions on efficiency and dependability (p < 0.001); the AI chatbot was rated highly novel but perceived as impractical and inefficient.
links.quote: The AI chatbot, despite being rated as highly novel, was perceived as impractical and inefficient.

unlisted_practices: High-fidelity manikin simulation to prospectively validate clinical practice guidelines before release

screen.reason: Evaluates clinician user experience and usability of an AI chatbot compared to paper protocol and digital apps for guideline adherence in high-fidelity pediatric emergency simulations.

primary.practice: AI chatbot vs paper protocol clinical usability testing in high-fidelity simulation
